descriptionMarkdown:
Set of microfactories I used for production on Fulgura, Gleba, Vulkanus and Aquillo.

Designs base on ideas from Nilaus videos.

2025.11.03

- added Aquillo designs (not rate optimized, enough for 40h achievement)
- new blocks for Gleba
- re-added generic blueprints for production and storage
- new blocks for Fulgora
  - recycling block expects source of whatever you want to recycle - I had drilling machines on scrap next to them

2025.09.26

Changes for Vulkanus.
- new blocks:
  - mining
  - refined concrete
  - electronic circuits (2x long)
  - rocket fuel (3x long)
  - landfill
  - small power block for 96MW (can be extended with up to three 116MW blocks)
 - changed blocks:
   - simple coal liquefaction can be repeated (three of them use whole red belt of coal)(
   -  red ammo has better rates 

2025.09.25
- generic block with only four substations
- new blocks on Vulcanus: 
  - initial solar power with accumulators
  - 116MW steam power (put it right behind steam generation one), can be connected to another one
  - simple coal liquefaction
  - water (via steam condensation)
  - heavy -> light oil
  - light oil -> petroleum gas (use light oil one and change recipe)
  - plastic


2025.09.17
- recreated book to contain Fulgora, Gleba and Vulkanus
- added some new factories

2025.07.15
- added Bioflux
title: Microfactories for Space Age
